question: The masculine aspect of the Manipuri classical dance is known as:
solution:
The answer is __**Choloms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Choloms: **Vigorous, rhythmic movements in **Manipuri classical dance**.
 
• Performed by both **male and female dancers.**
 
• Characterized by **fast footwork**, **graceful body movements**, and **intricate hand gestures**.
 
• Integral part of **Manipuri dance performances**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ras**

 
 
• **Ras **is a traditional **folk dance of Gujarat**.
 
• Performed during the f**estival of Holi**.
 
• Features energetic movements and **lively music**.
 
 
 
• **Pareng**
 
 
• **"Pareng" **is the **rectangular cloth** worn by** male dancers** in **Manipuri classical dance**.
 
• It is **draped around the waist** and **secured with a waistband**.
 
• Enhances the visual appeal of the **dancers' attire**.
 
 
 
• **Maiba**
 
 
• **"Maiba" **are **male performers** in **Manipuri classical dance**.
 
• They play important roles in **portraying characters**.
 
• Contribute grace, **strength, and skill to performances**.
